title: Dialogue Flow Designer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners order six dialogue stages for a CFO sales-practice agent, choose transition conditions including a strong/weak coaching branch, and see a live flowchart of their design.

learningObjectives: Design a dialogue flow for a sales conversation agent by arranging conversation stages and defining transitions.
prerequisites: Dialogue Systems and Conversation Flow sections of Chapter 5

controls: reorderable stage list with arrow buttons

keyQuestions: Design a dialogue flow for a sales conversation agent by arranging conversation stages and defining transitions.
commonMisconceptions: All conversations follow the same pattern.
assessmentOpportunities: All six stages in a logical order.
Exactly one strong/weak branch, placed after Response evaluation.
Learner can explain where the conversation must wait for the salesperson.
